name: BreizhCrops: Satellite Time-Series Crop Type Mapping Benchmark
description: BreizhCrops is an open-access multi-temporal satellite benchmark curated by the Technical University of Munich (TUM) and Stanford University to evaluate machine learning and deep recurrent architectures on satellite time series for agricultural monitoring. The dataset covers the entire Brittany (Breizh) administrative region of France, integrating over 582,000 agricultural field parcels across four French departments (Côtes-d'Armor, Finistère, Ille-et-Vilaine, and Morbihan). For each parcel, it provides continuous 45-step multi-spectral Sentinel-2 satellite observation time series paired with official European Land Parcel Identification System (LPIS) ground truth crop labels across nine principal agricultural categories.
